verdict.rationale: E-signature is a fair question for a document management and collaboration platform like SharePoint, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only the REST and Graph APIs, SPFx and webhooks, and contains nothing about a native e-signature feature or a documented first-party signing integration. Generic file CRUD and webhook primitives are developer building blocks and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an operations lead, signatures happen where the files live — a native e-signature product or documented first-party signing integration
